summary: Batch #5 backend + frontend verification (Family Tree, Birthday Wishes, Memory reactions/notes, Custom Group photo). BACKEND: 10/10 tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_batch5_api.py — memory react toggle (my_love true→false, love_count reflected in GET /timeline/{id}), notes list+add (author populated, comment_count increments), birthday wishes GET+POST for current year (shape {member, year, wishes[] with from}), 404 on unknown member_id (GET and POST), 400 on empty message, PATCH /chats/{id} {photo_url} on custom group returns avatar=photo_url (verified via GET), and correctly rejects family/direct chats with 400. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, storytester@fam.com/secret123): Family Tree — More → 'Family Tree' row (testID more-tree) opens the tree; renders 3 tiers (Grandparents/Parents/Children) with 5 tree-node-<id> nodes; tapping a node opens that member's profile (member-back visible). Birthday Wishes — from Meera's profile tap 'Birthday Wishes' (member-birthday-wishes) opens celebration screen with LinearGradient header; picking wish-emoji-🎉, typing in wish-input, tapping wish-send posts and the new wish card (wish-<id>) appears in feed and the '0 wishes' counter increments to '1 wish'. Home birthday-banner testID is visible and opens the same birthday screen. Memory reactions/notes — More → more-timeline → open a memory-<tid> card → memory-detail screen; tapping memory-love toggles heart+count (verified '1 love' → '0 loves'); typing in memory-comment-input and tapping memory-comment-send adds a note (memory-comment-<id>), note count increments (1 note → 2 notes). Group Photo — created a custom group (new-chat-btn → select 2 members → group-name-input 'TEST_batch5_photo_grp' → create-chat-btn), the gear (chat-manage-btn) opens Manage where group-photo-picker (camera-icon badge) is visible ('Tap to set a group photo' copy), tapping it does not crash on web (native picker doesn't open — EXPECTED per review note), group-rename-input + save-group-btn Save flow completes. NOTE: previously-flagged stale header on chat/[id] after group rename (iteration_4) is STILL PRESENT — after save the chat header shows the pre-save name until the screen is remounted. All testIDs in the review request are present and functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Same stale-header bug from iteration_4 is unresolved — after save-group-btn on /chat/manage pops back, the parent chat header still shows the pre-save group name (my test renamed to 'TEST_batch5_renamed_grp' but header remained 'TEST_batch5_photo_grp'). Fix: call loadChat() from the existing useFocusEffect in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx alongside loadMsgs(). Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:66-82

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on RN Web (carried over from iterations 1-4). Non-blocking.
Warning 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — expected because push is native-only. Not a bug.

action_items: (from iteration_4 — still unresolved) chat/[id].tsx: reload `chat` inside useFocusEffect (currently only loadMsgs refreshes on focus). One-line change resolves stale header after group rename or group photo save.
Optional: split server.py (2038 lines) into routers — timeline, birthdays, chats, seed, push — the 700-line guideline is significantly exceeded.
Optional: migrate pointerEvents JSX prop → style.pointerEvents to clear the RN Web deprecation warning (also flagged in iterations 1-4).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2038 lines — grew again with wishes + timeline reactions/comments endpoints. Router split overdue.

PATCH /chats/{id} silently drops caller's own member_id from remove_member_ids (line 1373 `ids.add(mine['member_id'])`) — still doesn't return an explicit 400, callers may be confused (documented in iteration_4).
WishIn.message has no length cap; POST /birthdays/{id}/wishes will accept arbitrarily long messages. Consider adding max_length via pydantic Field.

add_wish sends push using `send_push` and swallows the error — good — but note the push_ok side effect is dependent on placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY in preview (returns 500 for register-push, documented). Not a bug.

hydrate_timeline runs 3 extra Mongo queries per item in /timeline (love_count, comment_count, my_love) which is O(N) round-trips on the list. Fine for MVP (~10 memories) but should be aggregated for large families.

rca_of_issue: Stale group header after rename/photo save (still present from iteration_4). RCA: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx loads the chat object once in useEffect on mount but only re-fetches messages via useFocusEffect. When /chat/manage pops back after PATCH /chats/{id}, the parent screen refetches messages but keeps the stale chat state (old name/photo/member count). Fix: call loadChat() from the existing useFocusEffect callback (already calls loadMsgs).
